_note: Portfolio-wide 'is the market actually trending or just chopping' check (Kaufman Efficiency Ratio on the benchmark's own daily closes - see trader/filters/market_efficiency.py docstring for the full rationale and the concrete 2023-vs-2024-2026 finding that motivated this). DISABLED by default and mode='rank' (never blocks a trade) until backtested per strategy - flip 'enabled' to true and run scripts/tune_strategy.py --filters market_efficiency --strategy <name> to measure actual impact before ever considering mode='filter'. Per-strategy applicability moved out of this config on 2026-10-25 - see each strategy's own config `exclude_filters` list instead (sr_reversal excludes this filter - it's a range/reversal play that wants a non-trending tape, so gating it on market efficiency would be backwards; see trader/filters/base.py's class docstring for the full mechanism). A participating strategy's own config can also set `market_efficiency_override: {min_efficiency: ...}` to override default_min_efficiency below, just for that strategy.
